# ezghcloud_project (Resource)

An organization project. Deleting a project removes its access policies and starts its product cleanup; destroy contained resources first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Optional folder identifier; null places the project at the organization root.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project API identifier. Use this value in project_id attributes.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization of this project, from the provider configuration.
- `slug` (String) Canonical prj_ identifier used in IAM resource names.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_project.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID'
```
